oracle_contract.primary_success: Core upstream/native assertion success AND all exact canary/transport output checks; no missing required evidence. Report both components independently.
oracle_contract.grading: Harbor native verifier for builder. promptfoo native schema/Python assertions on retained native outputs for reviewer/researcher. Locally materialized task-specific extraction/assertion adapters remain local integration glue, not unchanged upstream tests.
oracle_contract.exact_comparison: Reject invalid UTF-8, duplicate JSON keys, nonfinite numbers, missing/extra keys, type mismatches and any changed lexical record field. Compare string bytes, including decimal scale and pin/hash case. Independent original source bytes are oracle; no model self-reported pass.
oracle_contract.required_negative_qualification: Every adapter/verifier must accept its known-pass and reject known-fail, malformed and missing evidence through its full extraction path before any model cell. Exercise numeric rounded integer, 1.5, wrong pin/hash and tail removed. Empty execution/zero tests/exit0 without real reward fails.
oracle_contract.blindness: Sanitized cell labels hidden from grader and human adjudicator; deterministic canonical output comparisons. Unexpected but potentially correct outputs retained as failures under frozen rule, no post-hoc oracle edits.

sequence: Turn 1: unchanged role task and at least one successful tool read; retain independent bytes and original call IDs.
Turn 2: ask for exact facts requiring prior tool output and another tool action, replay the real prior call_id/function_call_output and encrypted reasoning if returned.
Turn 3: require final exact record using earlier user provenance plus tail/numeric values, with another tool action; unchanged-file re-reads beyond scheduled tools count as recall.
multi_turn.header_scope: x-omniroute-session-id is read for live zone; Codex session_id and x-codex-turn-state have source paths; the connection pin is x-omniroute-connection (src/sse/handlers/chat.ts:688). Freeze how hop-local connection identity maps to the downstream account; equal strings across two different connection namespaces are not required. No invented account-id/connection-id headers. Actual propagation remains unobserved.

wire_fields.prompt_cache_key: stable unique session identity; separate across arms and repetitions

multi_turn.field_acceptance: Observe both ingress/egress hops privately. Assert stable cache/session identity within session, chosen account affinity unchanged, include remains effective, store=false accepted, encrypted reasoning bytes identical when replayed. If provider returns no encrypted item, mark that subcheck null and keep its gate open. No fabricated blob.
multi_turn.native_capability_gate: Harbor resume support is source-visible, but this exact three-turn/profile/transport protocol is not host-qualified. Repeats alone never close it.

Keyless absence of live-zone context calls compression again; determinism or other memoization may still preserve prefix. Optional paired keyed cells use registered 20129 principal and cacheMinutes=60.

Use role tool function_call_output for shell command plus protected read and unmatched call IDs; do not infer lite protection from codex-responses guards.
Exercise multipart/string key 1 collision and prove earlier user content unchanged; headerless cells must pass too.
Record applied/no-eligible/skipped/error per engine; a no-op is not engine acceptance.

Compare exact artifacts, all patch hunks, required explanations and schema completeness; byte-preserve every record field.
Read back effective styles and applied telemetry each request; no cross-cell shared settings races.

Keep credentials/account-bound reasoning private; log only equality booleans and salted identifiers.

Review, judgment, verification and evidence routes stay 20128 until their own frozen quality and exact-value gates pass.
Record-output preservation is mandatory even for builders; task success alone cannot promote record-producing roles.

metrics.definition: Binary first-attempt success: unchanged Harbor verifier complete pass for builder; promptfoo deterministic known-answer/schema grader for reviewer/researcher. Report core task score and combined task-plus-canary success separately; combined is primary.
Count rejected/error apply_patch tool invocations per session; session-any-failure indicator. Inapplicable tasks remain null for this component; any malformed required patch fails task.

Native nonzero verification invocations and missing/skipped/nonfinite rewards per session; intended starting red tests labelled separately; fixed protocol-required negative controls excluded from outcome denominator and charged to qualification.
Count corrective schema requests; maximum one fixed-reminder retry; initial failure remains in primary success and operational-failure rates.

An unrequested second read of the same normalized path, overlapping byte range and unchanged file SHA256 after a successful read; changed-file verification reads and mandated canary reads excluded. Count events and sessions, cite original/re-read call IDs; unresolved identity remains null.
20128.call_logs summed once per finalized request, task/session/user_turn and task.
Subset of tokens_in; report per-turn sum and fraction sum(cache)/sum(input), never mean of call fractions.
20128 subset of output, displayed separately, never added to output again.
20129 analytics before/after deltas for isolated owned window, with original/compressed tokens and pipeline-level savings. Never sum per-engine overlapping savings; never add to 20128 usage.
Monotonic start-to-terminal wall seconds per task and user turn, includes tool, compression, verification and retry time; gateway duration diagnostic separate.
All status 499 rows attributable to owned attempts plus local aborted-without-row attempts; aborted row counts and aborted session counts separate. No automatic replacement; unknown usage stays null.

accounting.total_billed_tokens_scope: Total provider-billed token positions, including cached input once, unweighted. This is not dollars; cached input can have a different price. Output is required because styles alter deliverables. Listed input/reasoning fields alone cannot determine the total.
accounting.economic_rule: Freeze applicable provider billing category/ratios before run for the warm-cache guard; never guess GPT-6 prices or infer dollars from compression analytics. Unknown rates leave economic result null.
accounting.join: Read-only final request rows deduplicated by row id, not timestamp/model. Attribute via private request/session correlation mapped to public ordinals and exact turn start/end. Serialize owned sessions; unrelated traffic or ambiguous join blocks scoring. Polling snapshots replace unfinished rows; never sum snapshots or gateway hops.
accounting.negative_or_missing: Require 0 <= cache_read <= tokens_in and 0 <= reasoning <= tokens_out; unknown/malformed/null usage remains null and makes cost winner ineligible. Never zero-fill missing 499 usage.
accounting.compression_snapshot: Owned exclusive 20129 analytics window before/after; no counter reset. Record totals/deltas and engine applied/skipped flags; if other traffic contaminates it, savings=null. Do not add engine subtotals to pipeline savings.
accounting.zero_denominators: No synthetic zero total, zero paired-session denominator or zero native tests. Ratios with missing/zero control usage are null and cannot qualify cost.

analysis.estimand: Each role separately: uniform six-task x two cache-condition mixture, paired by role/draw/task/cache assignment. Independent draws with replacement permit a binomial harmful-discordance gate; repeated task identities are not new task diversity.
analysis.failure_endpoint: Session has any unexpected apply_patch/verification failure, schema retry, invalid tool round trip, cancellation or missing output. Components and recall reported separately, no success-rate-only qualification.
analysis.noninferiority: For success, harmful discordance = C succeeds and candidate fails. For operational failure, harmful discordance = candidate has any failure and C has none. Each probability is a conservative upper bound on the corresponding net success loss/failure excess; require one-sided scipy.stats.binomtest(k, n, p=0.05, alternative="less") rejection after Holm. Require observed net success loss and failure excess <=0.05 as well. Paired trials, not calls, are n; task repetitions never represent distinct tasks.
analysis.assumptions: Independent paired outcomes under the preregistered random task/cache mixture and stationary provider conditions. Task/condition response rates may differ; randomized mixture supplies the marginal Bernoulli distribution. Retain assignment and time/block evidence. Failed randomization, material temporal dependence or backend/config drift makes certification inconclusive; no easier post-hoc method.

multiplicity.family: 3 roles x 4 candidate-vs-C comparisons x 2 co-primary harmful-discordance endpoints; missing/unrun comparisons get p=1; reject each relevant endpoint at family alpha .05.

analysis.bootstrap: scipy.stats.bootstrap paired=True, method=percentile, n_resamples=99999, rng seed=20260927. Resample complete paired session draws, preserving all five arms and all turns/retries/priming within a draw. Report 95% net success/failure and token-ratio CIs; warm-only resampling for economic guard. Descriptive intervals cannot replace NI tests.
analysis.permutation: scipy.stats.permutation_test permutation_type=samples, n_resamples=99999, alternative=less, rng seed=20260928, statistic mean(candidate_tokens-control_tokens) on paired complete session draws. Explanatory cost comparison only; nonsignificant equality is not non-inferiority.
analysis.degenerate_interval_guard: Zero-width/NaN bootstrap intervals are not proof. Exact harmful-discordance tests and one-sided exact binomial bounds still required; if these or assumptions cannot resolve margin, label inconclusive.
analysis.precision: Fixed sample/budget, no guaranteed power. Qualification data excluded from confirmation. A completed but underpowered cohort can only be inconclusive; no outcome-dependent extra repetitions.
analysis.ordering: For draw ordinal r use r mod 10 through [C,D0,A1,D1,A0], [D0,D1,C,A0,A1], [D1,A0,D0,A1,C], [A0,A1,D1,C,D0], [A1,C,A0,D0,D1] then their respective reversals. Add sorted role ordinal as cyclic schedule phase. Seal realized schedule before probes.
analysis.cache_design: Cold/warm labels are independent random draws with equal probability; expected 20 of each per task/cell. New task-scoped sessions each attempt, stable identity within session. Warm label has exactly one fixed same-arm native three-turn priming sequence in a separate session with shared stable task prefix; include its entire measured usage and latency. Cold label has no prime and fresh namespace. Actual coldness/warmth not assumed; measure first/second/third-turn cache fractions and actual affinity. Freeze prime task text and identity policy before probes; no cache flush.
analysis.sampling: Before first provider probe, NumPy 2.4.0 numpy.random.Generator(PCG64(20260927 + sorted_role_ordinal)) draws 240 independent integers in [0,12); integer//2 selects one of six sorted tasks and integer%2 selects cold/warm label. Freeze realized schedule bytes/hash, exact NumPy version and per-task counts. All cells use identical draws. No outcome-dependent rerandomization, balancing, replacement or minimum-count repair.
analysis.scored_vs_priming: 3600 is the scored role/cell attempt count only. Warm assignments add one unscored native priming session per cell, expected 1800 extra sessions; exact count is fixed by the pre-data schedule. Priming failures count against the associated scored attempt and all its usage/latency remains charged. Do not call the scored count total model sessions.

decision_rule.objective: minimum total billed tokens among non-inferior cells
decision_rule.eligibility: Complete matched cohort, effective max at 20128 on every attributable model call, unchanged effective control, passed native controls, 100% exact-value/record preservation, both NI endpoints Holm-rejected, full usage/transport evidence and stable cache strata. Any exact-value corruption vetoes the cell regardless of success rate. Apply absolute_quality_gate; no selection from all-failing tasks or absent task coverage.
decision_rule.cost_rule: Compare all-attempt sum(tokens_in + tokens_out) on identical completed role schedule including warm-up, retries, failures and cancellations. Minimum among eligible cells and C. Reject monetary-savings claims unless frozen price ratios and weighted billed input support them.
decision_rule.cache_economic_guard: Promotion additionally requires warm-stratum priced billed input and priced total not exceed C by more than 1% (upper one-sided 95% paired-block bootstrap ratio bound <=1.01). Unknown weights/degenerate unsupported bounds => no economic promotion; token ranking may still be reported descriptively.
decision_rule.tie_rule: Within 1% of minimum all-attempt tokens is a practical tie. Prefer C, then D0, D1, A0, A1 in that order; cost confidence intervals overlapping zero savings yield retain C pending another preregistration. No arbitrary latency tie-break after seeing data.
decision_rule.engine_rule: Only entire tested configurations qualify. A1 passing for researcher and failing for builder permits only scoped researcher A1; individual-engine exploratory winners require fresh confirmation. Broad role changes require a broader independently frozen representative task pack; these six-task results may qualify only their named domains.
decision_rule.incomplete: Any budget/telemetry/profile/transport gate, missing paired session or safety stop => incomplete or inconclusive, retain C. Keep all attempts and usage, never discard failed arms.
decision_rule.absolute_quality_gate: Control and candidate each require combined success >=0.90, with at least one real successful attempt of every selected task and nonempty exactness evidence. A trivially all-failing control cannot qualify a cheap treatment. A task omitted by the sealed random draw makes coverage incomplete; do not rerandomize after observations.

role_policy.builder_canary: Only isolated reversible builder trials after deterministic exactness and two-hop readiness; no early adoption, external publication or authoritative records.
role_policy.trial_vs_production: Reviewer/researcher treatment outputs are quarantined experimental artifacts graded independently on control/locally; their production routes remain 20128. No LLM grader in compressed arm.
role_policy.promotion: Role+configuration+task-domain specific; any broad review/evidence role needs representative confirmation and exact strings in verdict prose, receipts, pins and hashes. Stop on new record corruption and revert owned scope to control.

budget.unit: 20128 sum(tokens_in + tokens_out), both cache and output counted once; do not subtract compression savings
budget.admission: Before launch reserve measured worst-case next-session input/priming/tool continuations + output cap; estimate must fit remaining allocation with 600000 global reserve. Freeze supported per-request output/context limits after source/host qualification. If a hard upstream charge cap cannot be proven, report monitored soft cap with bounded cancellation overshoot; never call it enforced. Do not start confirmatory cohort if fixed schedule cannot reasonably fit based on qualification usage.
stop_conditions: Unknown/delayed usage beyond 30 seconds or ambiguous task attribution.
Budget reserve reached, timeout, quota/auth refusal, model/effort drift or config hash drift.
Exact-value or encrypted reasoning corruption, control verifier/malformed-control failure, uncontrolled shared traffic/settings.
Five consecutive 499/error requests or three cancelled sessions in any ten-session owned block; one record corruption stops that treatment immediately.
Missing required native profile/multi-turn capability; no substitute runner without amendment.
budget.owned_process_cancellation: Use native Harbor cancellation first; coordinator records own job/container/process group identities at launch. Stop launching, interrupt only that owned process group, allow 10 seconds, TERM then 10 seconds then KILL only surviving owned descendants; remove only owned sandbox resources through Harbor. Never pkill by model name, stop either gateway or kill unrelated sessions. Observe local death and separately reconcile 20128 terminal/499 rows for up to 60 seconds. Remote provider cancellation unproven remains null; no automatic retry, no erased partial cohort.
budget.restore: Future host owner restores the exact owned 20129 experiment configuration snapshot; never changes 20128. No host state was configured by this draft.

threats_to_validity: Prompt cache: peer historical ~94% does not establish current warmth; keyless live-zone bypass may or may not disturb deterministic prefixes.

Sharedgw adds a hop; default-only cells differ from C in hop and labelled-safe engines. No pure hop-only causal claim without additional globally-disabled/excluded framework control in a new protocol.
Session/account affinity, encrypted reasoning policy and fallback routing may change between hops; log actual identities privately and resolved model/effort.
Provider stochasticity and time-varying account capacity; fresh paired sessions, fixed order counterbalancing, same account affinity where supported, provider backend seed not assumed.
Five-cell time-sliced styles require exclusive ownership; config variants can disturb cache partition. Preserve snapshot hashes and report every transition.
Six fixed tasks per role and four builder smoke tasks constrain generalization; repetitions increase stochastic precision, not task diversity.
Promptfoo disk result cache would avoid model calls; use --no-cache. Keep native provider caching enabled and measured.
Enabled engine with no eligible input or missing optional model does not demonstrate that engine; engine interaction order and safe-label defects can dominate.
Repeated reads can be intentional; count only preregistered unchanged-file unrequested rereads; unknown artifact identity remains null.

evidence.draft_class: source-backed protocol and local structural validation only
evidence.public: Compact sanitized per-task/turn receipts, exact commands/exit results, upstream revision+file spans, hashes and equality booleans, failed attempts and unknown usage. Never generated summaries as upstream execution evidence.

before_run: Resolve all open host gates through maintained upstream commands, with no custom substitute harness.
Materialize task/canary bytes and compare frozen hashes; lock upstream dependencies/images, task graders, output schemas, native config and role definitions.
Run known-pass/known-fail/malformed controls in native harness; retain exact artifacts and outputs; hash adapters.
